messages:
maria (AE): FYI client POC hitting consistent 429s around 14:30 PST, started after load test. sending logs.

maria (AE): sample response headers: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests`, `X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1764830000` and body: `{ "error": "quota exceeded" }`

kai (SE): thanks — what's the org and route? can you paste `X-Route-Id` from the error header? also SDK version?

maria (AE): org=acme-corp, route=chat.generate.v1, X-Route-Id=route-4-prod, sdk-js@2.1.0

lucas (SRE): looking — I see per-route QPS caps for `chat.generate.v1` set to 10 req/s with burst 30, and token_budget_per_min=60k for trial orgs. during the ramp they hit ~28 req/s with large prompts (avg ~900 tokens) => exhausted token budget -> 429s.

amanda (SE): had they enabled streaming? large prompts + non-streaming increases token accounting. can you share sample prompt size and if embeddings/aux calls are included?

maria (AE): no streaming, prompt avg ~900, response ~350 tokens, also they call embeddings for similarity on each request (~1k tokens per embedding) — oops.

lucas (SRE): that explains it. we're enforcing both per-route rate and token budget. for POC we can do a temporary quota bump for 72h: raise token_budget_per_min to 300000 and route QPS to 50. want me to apply?

maria (AE): please, client is demoing tomorrow morning. also need an official note for pricing implications if sustained.

lucas (SRE): applying now — infra-bot will log change.

infra-bot: changed quota for org `acme-corp`: `token_budget_per_min` 60000 -> 300000, `route_qps` chat.generate.v1 10 -> 50, `burst` 30 -> 150. change_id=chg_20260303_42, expires_in=72h.

escalations (oncall): heads up — if this goes sustained we'll attach committed capacity recommendation. ping me if >24h sustained.

kai (SE): also recommend enabling streaming + request-level batching or reduce embedding calls. sharing a quick JS streaming snippet.

kai (SE): ```js
const resp = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-large', messages });
for await (const chunk of resp) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```

maria (AE): sent to client, they confirmed test ramped again and 429s dropped immediately :thumbsup: 

amanda (SE): add note to POC doc about per-route token budgets and embedding accounting so next AE doesn't get surprised.

maria (AE): filing brief summary in the POC thread and closing. thanks everyone :heart:
